extensions.question_or_target: Implementation target: a scheduled re-run of the replication packages that reports the FIRST day each one stops reproducing, with the environment delta since the last green. A package that silently rots converts a verified claim back into an unverified one without anyone noticing, and the loss is invisible precisely because nothing fails loudly.

scheduling.note: This unit delivers the watchdog CLI and missing-run detector. It does not install a system crontab or systemd timer on the estate.

extensions.title: Replication-package rot watchdog: detect the day a package stops reproducing

tool.name: replication-package-rot-watchdog
tool.purpose: Scheduled re-run of replication packages that emits SUCCESS:<pkg> or FAILED:<pkg> reason, stores the environment fingerprint with each result, reports first-fail day, and treats silence as FAILED.

tooling.first_fail_day_policy: set on first SUCCESS->FAILED (or first FAIL if never green); hold on later FAILs
invariants: Stdout is only terminal-state lines: SUCCESS:<pkg> or FAILED:<pkg> reason.
Environment fingerprints are persisted as canonical JSON bytes; deltas parse those bytes and never reconstruct a historical fingerprint from the live environment.
The first calendar day a package stops reproducing is stored and not rewritten on later failures.
Empty watchdog stdout, a missing scheduled run, or a package with no terminal line is FAILED, not green.
